name: Entombed Empress
description: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She’s been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.

abilities.name: Empty Husk
abilities.description: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

abilities.name: Missing Organs
abilities.description: The Empress’s internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

abilities.name: Grasping Chains
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals 2d8 physical damage, and temporarily Restrains them.

abilities.name: Deathless Obedience
abilities.description: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

abilities.name: Accursed Caress
abilities.description: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

abilities.name: Final Transformation (Phase Change)
abilities.description: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.
